title: closet.json
description: The wardrobe the stylist reasons over. One entry per garment. The real file is personal and is not published — see closet.sample.json for a runnable placeholder.

_meta.description: Who the wardrobe belongs to and the constants the stylist reasons from. This block is personal: it carries an email, a home location and a physical description. Keep it out of version control.

owner.description: Email the lookbook's feedback button drafts to. Optional — unset means the button copies to the clipboard instead.

location.description: Human-readable place, shown on the page

aesthetic.description: The target register, e.g. 'old money / quiet luxury'

palette.description: Colour families the wardrobe is built around

colouring.description: Complexion, hair and build. Drives which tones are flattering.

daily_contexts.description: Where the clothes actually get worn

id.description: Stable short handle, e.g. J1, T7, B3. Feedback refers to garments by this.

file.description: Path to the garment photo, relative to the project root

name.description: How a human refers to it, e.g. 'Dark brown puffer'

color.description: Free text, matched against the COLOR_HEX table in build_lookbook.py

warmth.description: 1 = summer-only, 5 = deep winter. Looks are capped at one warmth-3+ piece unless it is genuinely cold.

old_money.description: Whether the piece reads as quiet luxury. False pieces are used sparingly.

rain.description: How much weather the piece will take
